title: Yum
text: Yum. I dont like scents that are a flavor, vanilla, apples etc. I have always loved the older smokey,woodsy type scents that are harder to find and this one is it!!!! It is packed well and there is a thick insert in the box,so there isnt much a chance for breakage being in a glass holder. It is the size of a soda can. As soon as you open the first packaging you can smell it. The box even smells great! When I lit it, it didnt give off a strong scent but after about 1/2 hour or so, you could smell it. It is a very subtle scent and I could smell it in the air as I walked around the room. I am in love with this candle. It reminds me of bonfires in the woods.
